fusions.name: Flung Handful
fusions.desc: Throws a handful of filth at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, with a 30% chance to leave it [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Drumming Threat
fusions.desc: Beats your chest and stamps both feet, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Weakened] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Handstand Bluff
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Three Warnings Given
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
